measures.label: Plan
measures.description: Baseline times every driver. Editable: an edit becomes a scenario edit.

measures.label: Share of parent
measures.description: This row's plan as a share of the node above it.

measures.label: Baseline
measures.description: Statistical forecast net of the derived event and promotion effects.

measures.label: Stream view
measures.source: FACT_PLAN_INPUT.INPUT_CASES for the selected stream, else STAT_CASES
measures.description: The selected stream's own figure. Editing it submits that stream's input for approval.

measures.label: Consensus adjustment
measures.description: Effect of accepted sales, marketing and finance input.

measures.label: Planner adjustment
measures.description: Effect of the planner reconciliation and accepted agent proposals.

measures.label: Price response
measures.description: Volume response to the price change, from the shared elasticity assumptions.

measures.label: Landed cost per case
measures.description: Duty-paid cost plus ad valorem, the same build-up as V_LANDED_COST.

measures.label: Plan value
measures.description: Plan cases at the ex-works price after any change.

measures.label: Duty and tariff
measures.description: Tariff, excise and ad valorem on the plan.
